Fist Healer Syllving is a is a dwarven healer and a member of the Flaming Fist. She is on the streets of Lower City in Act Three.

Involvement

Act Three

Fist Syllving patrols the streets of the Lower City with  Fist Starrlet,  Fist Discoria and a  Steel Watcher. Their route runs back and forth from the bridge and gates to the Upper City to the Society of Brilliance Lodge (approximately from X: -195 Y: -10 to X: -196 Y: -68).

Syllving and her fellow Fists do not respond to any attempts to speak with them, regardless of whether the Steel Watch Foundry is intact or destroyed.
